Before removing and refitting the side Air Bag sensor following preliminary operations must be carried out: (1) turn the ignition key to the OFF position and extract it; (2) wait for 2 minutes before continuing; (3) remove the battery housing cover, disconnect the negative battery terminal and insulate the leads; (4) wait for 5 minutes before continuing.

FOLLOW ALL THE RECOMMENDED SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS (see assembly 5580C - AIR BAG SYSTEM).

Refitting

Op. 7040L40 REAR COMPARTMENT SCUFF STRIP - R R

- Partly raise the front floor.

1. Undo the retaining bolts.

2. Disconnect the electrical connection.

3. Remove the side Air Bag sensor complete with bracket.

1. Undo the retaining bolt.

2. Separate the side Air Bag sensor (2a) from the mounting bracket (2b).

Removing

- Position the side Air Bag sensor on the mounting bracket and tighten the fixing bolt.

- Connect the electrical connection.

- Position the side Air Bag sensor complete with mounting bracket and tighten the fixing bolts.

- Restore the position of the front floor.
